Commentary.Commentary: Adil Rashid was the standout bowler for England as he struck wickets and was economical as well. Plunkett too had a decent outing as he took crucial wickets with the new ball. Willey had an off day as he was expensive but the other England bowlers all did a reasonable job on what was a good batting pitch although the spinners did get some purchase later on in the innings. Sri Lanka do have something to bowl at due to that enterprising 8th wicket stand but they are surely about 25-30 runs below par on this wicket. A few early wickets can open the game though. Join us in a while for the chase.

A late flourish from Tharanga and Randiv got Sri Lanka to a respectable total but it was a disciplined performance overall from England with the ball. Having chosen to bat on a good pitch, skipper Mathews and Chandimal revived the innings with an 82-run stand for the fourth wicket after 3 wickets had gone quite early in the innings. At 159/3, the Lankans were seemingly heading for a really good score but Mathews' dismissal spurred a collapse as SL lost 4 wickets for 32 runs to slip to 191/7. However, Tharanga's unbeaten fifty and his unbroken 63-run stand with Randiv got the tourists past the 250-run mark.
Bye! Length ball angled away from outside off, Tharanga is beaten on the drive. They go across for the bye as Buttler misses the throw at the striker's end. SL FINISH ON 254/7.
Full toss outside off, Tharanga carves it over point with a slice as the ball goes to the deep for a brace.
Good length outside off, dabbed towards point for a quick single. Shy at the bowler's end misses as otherwise Randiv would have been gone by yards.
Low full toss outside off, drilled towards sweeper cover for a single. 250 up for SL.
Leg bye! Fuller on middle and leg, Randiv misses the flick and the ball rolls off the pads towards point. A leg bye taken.
29th ODI fifty for Tharanga.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.

Good length outside off, Randiv steps out and lobs it over the covers. On the bounce to the fielder as the batsmen come back for the second run. Buttle collects the throw and reverse flicks it on to the stumps. They go upstairs for the run out but Randiv is in comfortably.
They are going upstairs to refer a run out against Randiv.

FOUR! MORE LUCKY RUNS! Frustrating for England but the Lankans will be happy! Fuller outside off, Randiv has a go at it and gets a thickish edge that goes very fine to the third man fence for a boundary. Sri Lanka are squeezing out important runs in these death overs.
50-run stand between Randiv and Tharanga.
Low full toss outside off, slapped towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. This has been a vital stand for SL.
Full and outside off, Randiv thumps it dead straight past the bowler down the ground to long off for a brace.
Fuller on middle and leg, dug out towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! CARVED AWAY! Shortish outside off, wrong line and length from Willey and Tharanga cashes in. Stays on the back foot and slaps it over the covers with power to find the fence.
Full and outside off, nicely driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length on off, Tharanga pushes tamely at that one and is beaten as that went across him with the angle.
Full and wide outside off, Tharanga plays the square drive over point to get a brace.

SIX! MEATY BLOW! Shortish on middle and off, Tharanga stays on the back foot and powers the pull shot over mid-wicket. Struck it really well and that cleared the ropes with ease too. This is turning out to be a litle gem from the Lankan southpaw. Can he carry on till the end?
Low full toss on middle and off, Tharanga gets an inside edge on to the pads as he looks to flick.
Fuller and outside off, Randiv throws his bat at it and gets a slice over backward point for a single.
CHRIS WOAKES comes back on.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Randiv charges down the track and slices it over the covers to the deep for a brace as Woakes makes a fine stop near the ropes.

FOUR! CHEEKY FROM RANDIV! Length ball outside off, walks across the stumps and plays a scoop very fine past the keeper down the leg side to the fine leg fence for a boundary. All these are handy runs for the visitors. Every run will be valuable for them.
Length ball outside off, steered towards point for a run.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the back foot.

FOUR! More runs off edges! Length ball outside off, Tharanga pushes at that one and gets a thick outside edge that runs to the third man fence for a boundary. The Lankans won't care how they come as long as they come at this stage.
DAVID WILLEY comes back on.

ALMOST ANOTHER WICKET! Length ball outside off, pushed towards backward point. Randiv wanted a single but his partner didn't seem interested and the latter is made to go back. The throw from Roy at the striker's end misses as otherwise Suraj was in trouble.
Short of a length on leg stump, worked down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot towards point.
Short of a length around off, fended off the back foot towards backward point.
Length ball angled in on middle and off, Tharanga plays across the line but is hit on the pads. Muted lbw appeal but probably going down leg with the angle.
Shortish on middle and leg, tucked to the leg side for a run.
Fuller outside off, crunchy drive towards the covers.

RANDIV LIVING DANGEROUSLY! Length ball outside off, walks across to play a nothing shot. A half-hearted flick and the ball lobs high in the air. Just goes over the mid-wicket fielder and lands safely as a single is taken.
Short and around off, pulled towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers nicely to the deep where it is well stopped by Bairstow. A single taken.
Good length outside off, Tharanga goes for a slash but is beaten.
CHRIS WOAKES is back on.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga pushes it to the covers for a single.

FOUR! STREAKY BUT SL WON'T MIND! Length ball around off, Tharanga opens his bat face as the ball goes off the outer half towards the third man region. Got it fine unintentionally and the ball goes for a boundary. Welcome one for the tourists.

IN THE AIR....BUT SAFE! Shortish outside off, Randiv fends at that one and it goes uppishly to the left of backward point for a single. For a moment, it looked like that fielder there was going to take the catch.
Full and outside off, Randiv was early in the drive and spoons it towards mid off. Doesn't carry to the fielder.
Dug in short around leg stump, once again Randiv ducks under that one. No wide given, strangely.
Short of a length on middle and leg, Randiv ducks under that one.
Good length on middle and off, Tharanga goes back and works it to the leg side.
Good length outside off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller on leg stump, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball around off, pulled towards deep square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, driven through point for a single.
Length ball around off, Randiv lunges into it and nudges it to short cover. Went down the track for a single but is sent back just in time.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the covers for a single.
Short of a length outside off, bottom edge rolls towards point for a quick single.
Leg bye! Shortish on leg stump, Randiv misses the flick and the ball goes off the thigh pad towards backward square leg. A leg bye taken.
Fuller outside off, pushed off the front foot to the covers.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Randiv ducks under that one.
Shortish outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
LIAM PLUNKETT is back on.
Good length outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Randiv taps it to the off side.
SURAJ RANDIV comes out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Sri Lanka are imploding here! Full and around off, tailing in a touch and Maharoof played all around that one but ended up missing it completely. That disturbed the timber and England are having a great passage of play here. Wickets falling in a cluster for the tourists.
Length ball on off, Maharoof lunges into it to push at it and gets an inside edge through square leg for a brace. Had to hurry at the striker's end but the throw isn't that accurate.
Good length outside off, Maharoof taps it with soft hands to the covers.
Length ball outside off, pushed to cover for a single.
DAVID WILLEY comes back on.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders available outside the circle.
FARVEEZ MAHAROOF is the new man in.

OUT! WASTE OF A WICKET! It's a huge wicket too! Fuller on leg stump, worked towards short mid-wicket and Chandimal charged down for a non-existent single. Roy swoops in on the ball quickly and fires in a flat throw at the striker's end to Buttler who takes off the bails with ease. Dinesh wasn't going to make it back and that's a massive blow for Sri Lanka at this stage.
Drifting away outside off, cut away towards backward point.
Flatter on leg stump, clipped towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Flighted fuller on off, worked with the spin towards square leg for a single.
Darted on leg stump, tucked to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! CREAMED! Flighted outside off, lovely cover drive in the gap by Tharanga off the front foot and that races to the fence for a boundary. That should give confidence to the southpaw.
MOEEN ALI comes back on.
Full and around off, Tharanga pushes it towards mid off for a quick run. Wild throw at the striker's end but no overthrow taken. Ends a superb spell from Rashid 10-0-34-2.
Drops it short outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Sliding in from closer to off, Chandimal gets back and blocks it out.
Full and outside off, Chandimal drills it to the covers.
Half-tracker outside off, Tharanga mistimes the pull to long on for a single.
Loopy on a length around off, Tharanga plays the late cut to backward point.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Tharanga tucks it through backward square leg for a run.

FOUR! WAYWARD AND PUT AWAY! Shortish around leg stump, Tharanga goes back to pull and gets it very fine down the leg side past the keeper to the fence. There was an effort near the ropes but it was timid to say the least as the ball goes for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, chopped to the off side with a cut.
16th ODI fifty for Chandimal.
Fuller on middle and leg, Chandimal goes across and clips it to mid-wicket for a single. Fine knock thus far from him.
Floats it up on middle and leg, dug out to the right of Root who makes a diving stop.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked towards square leg for a single.
Drinks break!
Full and around off, Chandimal steps out and tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, turns into Tharanga as he misses the flick. Lobs up off the pads to first slip but there wasn't any edge on it.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted on middle and off, nice drift into Chandimal as he taps it back at the bowler with soft hands.
Tossed up around off, Tharanga works it with the spin towards long on for a single.
Fuller on middle and off, Chandimal gets an inside edge towards square leg.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.

Floats it up on middle and leg, Tharanga goes across to flick but is hit on the pads. Huge lbw appeal and looked close but perhaps there was an inside edge there. Replays confirm the edge and so, a good decision from the umpire.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Chandimal clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a single.
JOE ROOT comes back on.
Flighted on middle and off, Tharanga reaches out and jams it on to the track.
Tossed up around off, blocked off the front foot towards short cover.
Drifting in on middle and off, spins in a touch as Tharanga misses the flick to be hit on the pads.
Shortish outside off, cut away towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
UPUL THARANGA is the new man in.

OUT! STUNNER FROM WILLEY! Absolute stunner! Floats it up full on off, enticing the lofted drive and a nervy Prasanna goes for the big lofted stroke. Mistimed it straight up in the air as it went down the ground. Hales at long off and Willey at long on both go after it but it's the latter that finally makes the eventual dive to take an exceptional catch. Top fielding that and he is grinning happily at Hales. Ends a really careless stay at the crease from Prasanna.
Good length on middle and off, Prasanna pushes it towards mid on as they go for a quick single. Woakes misses the shy at the bowler's end but the batsman was in anyway.
Almost a repeat of the previous ball! Another half-tracker outside off, extra bounce as Prasanna is beaten on the pull again.
Shortish outside off, wild pull from Prasanna but he connects thin air.
Good length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.

Shortish on middle and leg, climbing into Prasanna as he looked to fend at it. Got something on it as the ball lobbed in the air towards the leg gully region. Lands safe as they get a single. No signal from the umpire so there definitely was some bat or glove on it.
Fuller and drifting on to the pads, clipped away through mid-wicket for a run.
LIAM PLUNKETT is back on.
Floats it up outside off, a well-disguised googly from Rashid as Prasanna is beaten on the cut. Some bounce there too. SL won't mind this turn and bounce too much though.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA is the new man in.

OUT! RASHID BREAKS THE STAND! Just what England needed! Floats it up outside off, a bit of extra bounce undid Mathews as he went for the slog sweep. He went a bit half-heartedly for the stroke and the result was a top edge to short fine leg where Plunkett settled under it nicely. This is exactly what the Lankans didn't need as this pair was batting smartly up till this delivery happened.
Flatter outside off, jabbed off the back foot to the bowler.
Tossed up fuller outside off, driven down to long off for another single. These two milking it around nicely.
Quicker and short on middle and leg, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Chandimal drills it to sweeper cover for a single.

Leg bye! Flatter outside off, Chandimal goes across to flick but the ball goes off the pads past the keeper towards third man. It spun back in a bit and that forced a stifled lbw appeal but it was optimistic to say the least. A leg bye taken.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Mathews wasn't ready and the umpire signals a dead ball.
Fuller on middle and leg, defended well off the front foot on to the ground.
Tossed up outside off, slow through the air as Chandimal thumps it down the ground to long off for one.
Flighted well outside off, Mathews drives it down to long off for a single.
Floats it outside leg stump, clipped through square leg for a single.
JOE ROOT comes into the attack.
Loopy on leg stump, worked through square leg for a single. Chandimal wanted the second but his captain rightfully denies it.
Floats it up outside off, Mathews lunges into it and taps it to the covers for a brisk single.
Drifting in on a length around off, pushed off the back foot to cover-point for a single.
Slightly short on middle and off, punched off the back foot towards extra cover.
Loopy on leg stump, Mathews nudges it towards square leg for a quick single.
Drifting in on a length on off, worked off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked off the back foot down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller outside off, driven well off the front foot to mid on.
Shortish around off, Mathews' turn to play the pull on the advance but mistimes it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Good length outside off, steered down to third man for a run.

FOUR! CARTED AWAY! Shortish ball on middle and off, Chandimal charges down the track and muscles the pull over mid-wicket. Made terrific contact as the ball raced to the fence for a boundary. Could break the shackles a bit for him.
Shortish on middle and leg, climbs on Mathews as he tucks it down to fine leg for a single. Looked awkward playing the shot.
Loopy on a length on off, punched off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Fuller and around off, driven off the front foot back to the bowler.
Drifting in around off, defended well off the front foot on to the track.
Quicker ball on a length on leg stump, worked through square leg for a brace.
Tossed up wider outside off, a bit full and Mathews drives it well but straight to the man in the covers.
Tossed up around off, lovely front foot defense by Mathews.
Fuller and on off, driven straight back down the track as the ball hits the non-striker's stumps. Muted appeal for a run out but it didn't hit Plunkett's hands and Mathews was in his crease anyway.
Length ball on off, chipped uppishly towards short mid-wicket but just short of Ali.
Good length outside off, defended well off the back foot.

FOUR! CALCULATED RISK PAYS OFF! Good length angled in on to the pads, Chandimal steps out to that one and lobs it high over backward square leg to the fence for a boundary. Was in the air but right in the gap between fine leg and deep square leg.
Length ball on middle and leg, Angelo steps out and works it through backward square leg for a run.
Fuller on off, Mathews goes across and digs it out to short mid-wicket.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes back into the attack.
Drifting in outside off, pushed off the front foot to cover.
50-run stand between Chandimal and Mathews.
Four Leg byes! More runs! Drifting in on leg stump, Chandimal misses the sweep and the ball goes off the pads. There was a leg slip in place but it goes to his right as the ball speeds to the fence.
Fuller outside off, tapped towards cover for a single.
Sliding in on middle and off, Mathews gets back and nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle and off, worked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! NOT IN CONTROL BUT A BOUNDARY NEVERTHELESS! Floated on middle and leg, Mathews goes for the sweep and the ball goes off the top half of the blade. Got it fine down the leg side pas the keeper as it raced to the fence for a boundary.
Quicker ball on off, flicked off the back foot towards square leg.
Drifting in on a length on to the pads, worked down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller on middle and leg, Chandimal sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Full on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Floats it up on middle and off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, clipped down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller on middle and off, driven down to long off for a single.

HOW DID THAT MISS! Floats it up on middle and off, Chandimal goes for the reverse sweep and converted it into a full toss but misses it. The ball goes through his legs and misses the stumps by a whisker as it goes through to Buttler. Boy, the Lankan keeper batsman is one lucky guy for sure. There was some turn and bounce there as otherwise he was a goner.
Tossed up nicely outside off, driven firmly to the covers off the front foot.
Drifting in on a length outside off, some turn away as Chandimal is beaten on the poke off the back foot.
Loopy leg break outside off, Chandimal gets a faint inside edge on to the pads as he looks to block.
Fuller on off, defended off the front foot nicely to short mid-wicket.

Chandimal seems to have pulled his hamstring a bit during running in the previous over. The medical staff is attending to him. His captain is already having a hamstring injury of sorts and SL will hope that their keeper is fine. A delay in proceedings then.

FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! Short and wide outside off, poor ball from Ali and the SL captain feasts on it with a superb cut through point to find the fence. That completes a really good over for the Lankans.
Fuller on off, pushed nicely towards mid on.
Flatter outside off, Mathews gets back and plays it very late with an open bat face towards third man for a brace as Rashid makes a superb stop near the fence.
Fuller on off, worked towards mid-wicket with soft hands for a single.

Two Leg byes! Floats it up outside off, Chandimal shuffles across the stumps to sweep and the ball goes off the pads past the keeper towards third man. Buttler was anticipating the batsman to make contact and moved to his left too early thereby missing the ball. Willey makes a good stop near the ropes to keep the batsmen down to a brace. They go upstairs to see if Willey's foot touched the ropes but he did a good job.
Fuller on middle and off, driven down to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to cover for a single.

Floats up on a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover. Roy's throw at the striker's end isn't gathered cleanly by Buttler and the batsmen get a single off the overthrow. That was sloppy fielding.
Slightly short outside off, cut away through point for a single.
Floats it up outside off, Chandimal thumps it down the ground to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, driven nicely off the front foot through the covers for a single.
Drifting in on a length outside off, jabbed off the back foot to the bowler.
Loopy and outside off, Chandimal leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
Flatter on a length outside off, punched off the back foot to long off for a single.
Four Leg byes! Tossed up outside off, Mathews goes for another slog sweep but misses. The ball goes off the pads through Root at first slip as the ball races to the ropes.
Drifting in on off, whipped off the front foot towards short mid-wicket.
Floats it up outside off, Mathews goes for the slog sweep and gets a top edge on it. Fine leg is in the circle and hence the ball lands safe in the outfield.
Quicker on a length outside off, blocked off the back foot down the track to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, Chandimal moves across on his front foot and laps it down towards fine leg for a brace.
Tossed up outside off, pushed off the front foot to the covers.
Flighted fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot down the track.
Loopy on leg stump, tucked towards square leg for a quick run.
Drops it short and outside off, cut away nicely through backward point to the deep as Woakes makes a good stop running to his left from sweeper cover. A brace taken.
Flighted fuller on leg stump, worked in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Spin from both ends now as ADIL RASHID comes on to bowl.
Fuller on off, defended well off the front foot.
Drifting in outside off, Chandimal goes well across and plays the lap sweep down to fine leg for a single. Top edge but goes through the vacant short fine leg region.
Fuller on middle and off, worked towards the leg side.
Fullish on middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket. They decide against the single as Roy swoops in on the ball but fumbles to let it through the infield. Single taken eventually.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly but straight towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! HAMMERED! After a series of good deliveries, Ali bowls a full toss and Mathews doesn't miss out. Brings out the sweep through square leg and hits it really hard to find the fence.
Fuller on middle and leg, Mathews goes well across and clips it towards square leg for a single.
Pitched up outside off, gets across to that one and blocks it well off the front foot.
Fuller on middle and leg, nicely glanced through mid-wicket by Mathews for a brace. The SL captain gets off the mark.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot towards point.
Length ball outside off, kept a bit low as Mathews stabbed it towards point.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal runs it down to third man for a single.
Flighted nicely around off, Mathews taps it towards short mid-wicket. Tidy stuff from Ali.
Fuller on off, Dinesh wrists it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Darted on middle and off, Chandimal clips it towards mid-wicket.
Sliding in on middle and leg, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover on the front foot.
Full and on off, worked towards square leg.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, defended nicely off the front foot to the covers.
ANGELO MATHEWS is the new man in.
Drinks break....

OUT! SUPERB FIELDING! Needless from Chandimal and Perera has to pay the price! Length ball outside off, attempted steer to third man goes off the bottom edge towards Roy at backward point. Dinesh wanted the single and Kusal responds although it was always going to be dangerous. The throw at the striker's end hits the bulls eye and Perera is well short. Big wicket for England that as the southpaw was looking dangerous. Great fielding from Roy as he collected with his left hand and then fired the throw with his right in a flash of seconds.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot towards the covers.
Good length on middle and leg, worked through the leg side for a run.
Length ball on middle and off, worked it uppishly wide of the man at short mid-wicket for a single.
Sliding in outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Fuller on middle and off, worked towards mid-wicket.

Drifting in from outside off, Chandimal goes across for the paddle. Buttler anticipated it well and moved to his right but couldn't grab it as the ball raced towards fine leg for a run. It hit the England keeper high on the pad.
Fired on to the pads, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
Sliding in on middle and off, jabbed off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Floats it up on leg stump, Kusal steps out and gets a bat-pad that rolls on to the track.
Length ball outside off, crunched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a run.

Length ball on leg stump, Chandimal steps out to flick but the ball goes off the pads towards square leg as the batsmen cross over. No signal from the umpire and so there might have been some bat on it.
Pitched up outside off, driven nicely by the batsman towards mid off.
Fuller on middle and off, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle and off, lofted down the ground by Perera towards long on. Didn't quite get hold of it as Plunkett does the fielding near the ropes by moving to his right. Single taken.
Good length around off, blocked off the back foot back to the bowler.
DAVID WILLEY comes back on.
Full and on off, worked through square leg for a brace.
Slightly short on middle and off, punched off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, blocked off the front foot nicely.
Loopy on off, Perera blocks it off the front foot nicely.
Fuller on middle and leg, swept nicely down to fine leg for a run.
Flatter around leg stump, Chandimal misses the flick and is hit on the pads. Appeal for lbw but that was missing leg.
Fuller and on off, nicely blocked off the front foot towards mid off.
Good length on off, Chandimal gets it off the inside half of the bat down to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! UPPISH BUT SAFE! Fullish outside off, lazy drive from Chandimal without any footwork. In the air but just goes to the right of the point fielder as it gets to the fence. A bit risky but it came off for Dinesh.
Length ball outside off, defended well off the front foot to the covers.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal looks to drive and gets it off the bottom half of the blade to the covers.
Length ball outside off, nice bounce and carry as Chandimal leaves it alone.
Fullish on middle and leg, Perera clips it through backward square leg as they scamper through for another brace.
Drifting in on middle and off, Kusal steps out and whips it through wide mid on for a brace
Tossed up outside off, driven down the ground towards long on for a single.
Loopy on middle and leg, clipped to the left of short mid-wicket for a quick run.
Drifting in on middle and off, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
Floats it up on a length on off, defended well off the back foot.
First signs of spin in the game as MOEEN ALI comes into the attack.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Slightly back of a length around off, back foot pull from Perera towards mid on for a single.
Fullish outside off, Dinesh lunges into it to push at it and gets it off the inside half of the blade through mid-wicket for a run.
Short of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot on to the pitch.
Good length on leg stump, worked away towards mid-wicket for an easy single.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal shuffles across and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Four fielders are allowed outside the circle now.
Good length on off, Chandimal nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, pushed towards the covers with soft hands.
Length ball on to the pads, clipped towards backward square leg for a single.
Slightly fuller around off, Chandimal gets an inside edge towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, blocked off the back foot towards cover.
Good length on leg stump, worked towards square leg for a single.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, late away movement as Chandimal is beaten on the poke. Plunkett is on song at the moment.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the new man in. Two slips in place for the new batsman.

OUT! GOT HIM! It's Plunkett again! After a barrage of shortish deliveries, he delivers a slightly fuller ball around off, jags back in a touch to rap Mendis on the pads as he misses the flick. The lbw appeal is upheld quickly by the umpire and it's a duck for Mendis. Only height could have saved him and replays show that it was clipping the stumps. So, a good decision not to review it. Plunkett is on a roll with his second scalp in as many overs.
Shortish outside off, good bounce for Plunkett as it hits the splice of Mendis' blade as he looks to block off the back foot.
Length ball around leg stump, Mendis misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads to the leg side.
Good length on middle and off, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Fullish outside off, some width and Perera unleashes his favorite slice over backward point. Cleared the infield with ease as the ball raced to the fence for a boundary.
Fullish outside off, pushed off the front foot towards extra cover.
Wide! Length ball drifting down the leg side, Kusal doesn't connect the flick and that's a wide.
Slightly short outside off, Mendis hops around to fend it towards backward point.
Good length around leg stump, Mendis misses the flick and the ball rolls off the pads towards backward square leg. Perera wanted the single and was down the track but is sent back.
Length ball on leg stump, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length on off, defended well from the crease.
Floodlights have been switched on early due to the overcast condition around the ground. Plenty of dark clouds hovering around.
Fuller and around off, driven nicely towards cover-point.
Length ball outside off, blocked well off the back foot the off side. Good over from Plunkett barring the horror first ball. A successful one as well.
Good length on off, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Wide! Short of a length on leg stump, goes down the leg side with extra bounce as Mendis misses the flick. It's a wide.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in. So, we've two Kusals out there at the moment.

OUT! GONE THIS TIME! Perera survived but Gunathilaka didn't! Another good delivery from Plunkett, slightly fuller outside off, inviting the drive and Gunathilaka obliged, without any footwork though. Got a nick through to Buttler who pouched it with ease. The bowling change does the trick for England but Gunathilaka has only himself to blame for this. He's thrown it away.

EDGED BUT SAFE! Length ball outside off, a bit of shape away as Perera pushes at that one. Gets a thick edge but the second slip isn't in position and the ball goes through that vacant region towards third man for a run.
FOUR! CRASHED! Full toss outside off, real loosener from Plunkett to start and Perera isn't going to miss out on such freebies as he bashes it wide of mid off to find the boundary.
Time for a change then. LIAM PLUNKETT comes on to bowl.
Outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller outside off, pushed to the covers.

Length ball outside off, width on offer and Perera cuts it off the back foot through backward point. Plunkett at third man runs across to his left and this time makes a good stop, unlike his earlier blip. Two runs taken.
Back of a length around off, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot back to the bowler.
Good length well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball wider outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length outside off, defended well off the front foot.

SIX! A ONE-HANDED BIGGIE! Wow! Full and outside off, Gunathilaka decides to hit through the line down the ground but almost checks his shot a bit. One hand came off the blade in the process but he didn't lose his shape at all to send the ball over long off for a maximum.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards the covers.

SIX! KABOOM! Gunathilaka goes aerial! Fullish and closer to off, the southpaw shuffles across to that one and clubs it high over long on for a big maximum. Just enough cleared the ropes there but was struck really well.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Fuller and outside off, wisely left alone to the keeper.
Length ball around off, Danushka looks to block and gets a thick inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller and around off, Gunathilaka goes across to that one and wrists it towards mid-wicket for a single. Came off the toe end of the blade.
Length ball closer to off, defended off the back foot back at the bowler.
Short ball on off, pulled away in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Slightly fuller outside off, Kusal drives it well towards mid off.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked towards short fine leg where Rashid makes a good stop. Single taken nevertheless.
Good length outside off, Kusal taps it towards point with soft hands.
Fuller around off, blocked well off the front foot.

FOUR! POOR FROM PLUNKETT! Fuller on to the pads, Perera shuffles across and whips it through mid-wicket with a languid followthrough of the blade. The ball races to deep mid-wicket as Plunkett gives a long chase to stop the ball but undoes all his hard work by a mediocre dive to concede the boundary.
Length ball outside off, tapped off the back foot towards extra cover. Quick single taken as Morgan misses the direct hit at the bowler's end. Might have been close for Danushka had that hit.
Fuller and tailing in from around off, driven nicely towards mid on.

DROPPED! That ball was travelling! Length ball angled away outside off, some width and Kusal threw his bat at that one. Flashed really hard and the edge flew towards second slip where Hales got a hand to it but couldn't cling on. The ball goes off his hands through the cordon as the batsmen get a single. Sharp chance but these need to be taken at international level.
Fullish drifting on to the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Good length around off, defended from the crease back to the bowler.

Length ball around leg stump, Danushka goes across to flick but is hit on the pads as the ball rolls to the off side. Appeal for lbw but is turned down as the batsmen cross over. No signal from the umpire and so that means he thought there was an inside edge. Might have been a tad high.
Dug in short on middle and off, Gunathilaka thought of the pull but aborts it at the last moment as he taps it on to the track.
Length ball outside off, backhand slap off the back foot from Perera. Not timed that well but found the gap in the covers as the ball trickled towards the deep. Three runs added to the total.
CHRIS WOAKES to take the other new ball.

FOUR! CRUNCHED! Elegant stroke! Half volley from Willey outside off, too full and Gunathilaka pounces on it with a scorching drive through the covers. Split the gap well and the ball rocketed to the fence.
Good length outside off, moving away this time as the batsman leaves it alone to the keeper.
Fullish on off, a bit of tail into the batsman as Gunathilaka whips it with the swing towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and off, accurate line and Gunathilaka pushes it back down the track to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, tapped gently towards short cover as they go for a quick single. Shy at the bowler's end misses but Kusal was in anyway.
Full and around off, some swing away as Perera taps it with the movement towards point with soft hands.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. KUSAL PERERA and DANUSHKA GUNATHILAKA to open the batting for the Lankans. DAVID WILLEY has the brand new white ball with him and will start proceedings for England. Two slips in place. We are ready to go!
England are playing with the same XI while Sri Lanka have made a change - Suraj Randiv comes in for Dasun Shanaka.
Time for the toss. Eoin Morgan to flip the coin, Angelo Mathews to call. The visiting captain has called it correctly. SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of game 2 of the 5-match ODI series between England and Sri Lanka at Edgbaston in Birmingham. If the first encounter between the two sides is any indication, we are likely to have another pulsating duel between the two sides. Difficult to say which side has the momentum after the thrilling tie in the last ODI but England surely are the happier side as they escaped a certain defeat. Sri Lanka will be gutted at the lost opportunity but there are positives for them too as they head into this crucial game of the series. Another defeat for the tourists will make it difficult for them to come back. Skipper Angelo Mathews' fitness will be a worry for the Lankans. The toss is coming up shortly.
